text: oneil: "day_vol 1.35 misses C16." My trigger needs volume at or above 1.2x its average on a top-third close (C12). day_vol 1.35 clears that. My entry is not a breakout bar anyway. It is a last point of support inside a markup: a dip under the rising trendline that closed back above it (C7), and that is not judged on breakout volume. What I cannot see is the bar sequence; this runs on a one-row proxy. The entry is an hourly close above bar_high. A daily close under bar_low, or back under the trendline, ends it.
